description: ignoreDeps: ubuntu runners must stay on the oldest supported version.

gitIgnoredAuthors: biome-migrate.yaml commits the migrated biome.jsonc to a Renovate branch as github-actions[bot]; without this, Renovate takes that commit for a manual edit, marks the pull request as edited and stops updating it.
mise.lock pins a checksum and a URL per tool per platform, but a local `mise install` re-locks only the platform it runs on and silently leaves the others stale.
Lock file maintenance runs plain `mise lock`, which refreshes every tool on every platform already in the file.
Defaults are disabled and weekly, hence the explicit settings. The packageRules keep it to mise.lock.

packageRules.description: No lock file maintenance by default.
Lock file maintenance for mise.lock only.

customManagers.description: Renovate hints after a comment: `# datasource=<datasource> depName=<depName>`. A trailing ! of a version pinned in .trunk/trunk.yaml is left out of the version.
